question:
Observe the figure below and find the area of trapezium PQRS.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1beded7d01686947caabd4e136b4c597f7d872499a3b6c1d5427d342885e3b15.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Trapezium PQRST with sides PQ = 9 cm, PR = 15 cm, RS = 8 cm.

**Formula used:**

Area of trapezium = ½ × (Sum of parallel sides) × Height between parallel sides

Height2 = Hypotenuse2 - B
